request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: May the UR10e arm of the cell be put into service on the sole basis of the declaration supplied by its manufacturer, before the complete robot cell has been declared in conformity?

response.text: {"kind": "boolean", "value": false, "text": "No. Under Directive 2006/42/EC, a partly completed machine such as the UR10e may not be put into service until the final machinery it is incorporated into has been declared in conformity. The manufacturer's declaration of incorporation must state this (Annex II, part 1, section B, point 6), and Article 5(2) and Article 13(1) require the manufacturer's procedure to be completed before the product is placed on the market.", "sources": [{"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Annex II, 1, B. Declaration of incorporation of partly completed machinery, point 6", "quote": "a statement that the partly completed machinery must not be put into service until the final machinery into which it is to be incorporated has been declared in conformity with the provisions of this Directive, where appropriate"}, {"file": "DIR.md", "place": "Article 13, paragraph 1", "quote": "The manufacturer of partly completed machinery or his authorised representative shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that: (a) the relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B is prepared; (b) assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared; (c) a declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B has been drawn up."}]}
